newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela's PDVSA to pay $2.1 bln dividend for '96.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela's PDVSA to pay $2.1 bln dividend for '96.

text.p: Venezuelan state oil company Petroleos de Venezuela (PDVSA) will pay the government a dividend of about one trillion bolivars ($2.13 billion) for its 1996 fiscal year, Energy and Mines Minister Erwin Arrieta said Tuesday.
"PDVSA will pay an estimated one trillion bolivars in dividends," Arrieta told reporters in Congress.
PDVSA made its first ever dividend payment of 393 billion bolivars (equivalent to $1.4 billion at the end of 1995) for its 1995 fiscal year.
"Higher (oil) prices, operational and management improvements are reflected in these dividends which are also an index to measure the company's efficiency," Arrieta said.
PDVSA pays its dividends, 67 percent income taxes and a 17 percent royalty tax to Venezuela's government.
The oil company is expected to hand over $7.785 billion to the government in taxes and dividend payments this year.
PDVSA officials have said they expect the company to make a $4.4 billion net profit in 1996 up from $3.1 billion last year.
